title: Roadmap - Releases, Upcoming Features and Improvements

pageBlocks.byLine: Welcome to EagleEye's public roadmap! This is a live document and will be updated regularly

items.title: Outlook Integration
items.description: Connect Microsoft 365 and EagleEye scans your email every night, including your past emails.

items.title: Customer Portal
items.description: View your reports, manage your tags and track your scans in one place.

items.title: Azure Marketplace App
items.description: Install EagleEye from the Azure Marketplace straight into your own Azure subscription.

items.title: GitHub Integration
items.description: Scan your GitHub issues and pull requests, then AI-tag and report on them just like your email.

items.title: MCP Integration
items.description: Ask Claude or GitHub Copilot about your EagleEye data directly, read-only and turned on by an administrator.

items.title: Team Mailboxes
items.description: Analyze the email and reply times of shared mailboxes like support@ and sales@, by mailbox rather than by person.
